title: Google Overhauls AI Leadership As DeepMind CEO Steps Aside - Slashdot
excerpt: Google is reshuffling its AI leadership as Demis Hassabis steps away from day-to-day management of DeepMind to become chairman and Alphabet's chief scientist, while CTO Koray Kavukcuoglu takes operational control. content_html:
Google is reshuffling its AI leadership as Demis Hassabis steps away from day-to-day management of DeepMind to become chairman and Alphabet's chief scientist, while CTO Koray Kavukcuoglu takes operational control. Meanwhile, longtime chief scientist Jeff Dean and several prominent researchers are leaving to launch their own company. Axios reports: Hassabis will add the title of chief scientist for Google parent company Alphabet and also continue to lead Isomorphic Labs, the company's AI drug discovery spinoff. Koray Kavukcuoglu, the current chief technology officer of Google DeepMind will serve as senior VP of the unit, reporting to CEO Sundar Pichai.

Dean, a 27-year Google veteran is starting Discovery Loop, an independent publicity benefit corporation in which Google will be an investor and cloud provider. Joining him in that effort are Google senior fellow Sanjay Ghemawat as well as Oriol Vinyals, a DeepMind VP and Quoc Le, a Google Brain co-founder.

[...] In an interview with The New York Times, Dean indicated that leaving Google, a public company, gives him more leeway to focus on scientific discoveries associated with AI as well. "We might make decisions that are not necessarily in the company's purist financial interests," he told NYT.

"I've been working towards AGI my whole life and now, like many of you, I feel it is close at hand," Hassabis wrote. "It's critical that we collectively get the next steps right to ensure this all goes well for humanity and we usher in an incredible new age of discovery and wonder."

"With this backdrop, I've decided that now is the right time for me to hand over my day-to-day operational responsibilities at GDM, so that I have the time and space to focus on the big picture and help influence what is to come to the best of my ability"

谷歌正在重组其人工智能领导层，Demis Hassabis 不再负责 DeepMind 的日常管理，出任董事长兼 Alphabet 首席科学家，而首席技术官 Koray Kavukcuoglu 则接管运营控制权。 与此同时，长期担任首席科学家的杰夫·迪恩（Jeff Dean）和几位著名的研究人员即将离职，创办自己的公司。 Axios 报道：哈萨比斯将增加谷歌母公司 Alphabet 的首席科学家头衔，并继续领导该公司的人工智能药物发现分拆公司 Isomorphic Labs。 谷歌 DeepMind 现任首席技术官 Koray Kavukcuoglu 将担任该部门的高级副总裁，向首席执行官 Sundar Pichai 汇报。 Dean 是一位在 Google 工作了 27 年的老员工，他正在创办 Discovery Loop，这是一家独立的宣传福利公司，Google 将成为该公司的投资者和云提供商。 与他一起努力的还有 Google 高级研究员 Sanjay Ghemawat、DeepMind 副总裁 Oriol Vinyals 和 Google Brain 联合创始人 Quoc Le。 [...] 迪恩在接受《纽约时报》采访时表示，离开谷歌这家上市公司，让他有更多的余地来专注于与人工智能相关的科学发现。 “我们可能会做出不一定符合公司纯粹财务利益的决定，”他告诉《纽约时报》。 哈萨比斯写道：“我一生都在为通用人工智能而努力，现在，像你们中的许多人一样，我觉得它已经近在咫尺。” “至关重要的是，我们必须共同采取正确的下一步措施，以确保人类一切顺利，并迎来一个令人难以置信的发现和奇迹的新时代。”

“在这种背景下，我决定现在是我移交 GDM 日常运营职责的最佳时机，这样我就有时间和空间专注于大局，并尽我所能帮助影响未来的发展”
